result: h07. **URL the browser requests** — `convertUserFromStore` rewrites a base64 avatar into a path so the profile image is fetched as a plain ``: `userpb.AvatarUrl = fmt.Sprintf("/file/%s/avatar", userpb.Name)` (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`), rendered by `UserAvatar` (`web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx:13`). So the browser GETs `/file/users/{username}/avatar`. Hops from that request to stored data: ``` RegisterRoutes (GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121 serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 getCurrentUser (only when !Profile.AllowAnonymous) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:708 Authenticator.AuthenticateToUser — server/auth/authenticator.go:190 getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 Store.GetUser (FindUser{Username}) — store/user.go:148 Store.ListUsers (userCache write-through; cache read only on find.ID) — store/user.go:136 Driver.ListUsers (interface) — store/driver.go:47 DB.ListUsers (SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user WHERE username = ?) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 parseDataURI (decode data:;base64,... into bytes) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737 c.Blob (after avatarAllowedTypes check + security/cache headers) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:207 ``` Notes: - The avatar bytes live in the `user.avatar_url` column as a base64 data URI — there is no blob/S3/local-file hop like attachments have; `parseDataURI` is the decode step. - Driver selection happens once at startup (`NewDBDriver`, `store/db/db.go:14`); the MySQL/Postgres equivalents of the final hop are `store/db/mysql/user.go` and `store/db/postgres/user.go`. - Service wiring: `fileserver.NewFileServerService` + `RegisterRoutes` at `server/server.go:81-82`, registered before the gRPC gateway. - Access control is inside the handler, not middleware: anonymous requests are rejected only when `Profile.AllowAnonymous()` is false; otherwise any user's avatar is public.
